section.title: Result push
section.description: Push this automation's run results to Feishu without changing the agent prompt.
section.empty: No push targets yet. Results stay here until one is added.
section.read_only: Result push follows this automation's write permission. You have read-only access.
section.unsupported: This server doesn't support result push yet. Ask the operator to upgrade the server.
section.sending_unavailable: Feishu sending isn't configured on this server, so saved targets can't deliver. Ask the operator to enable it.
section.no_bot: No Feishu bot is installed in this workspace. Install one under workspace settings first.

content_mode.hint_create_issue: This automation creates tasks, so pushes are a status card with a task link — no report body.
content_mode.hint_empty_output: A run without report content is delivered as “(no report body)”.

delete_dialog.title: Delete this push target?
delete_dialog.description: Queued messages to this target are cancelled; delivery history is kept.

routes.toast_conflict: This configuration was changed elsewhere. It has been reloaded — review and try again.

editor.message_id_hint: The bot replies to this message in a thread. It must belong to the chat above.
editor.approval_admin: This target hasn't been approved yet. Saving approves it as a workspace admin and verifies the bot can reach it.
editor.approval_member: Group chats and topics require approval by a workspace owner/admin before saving.
editor.approval_pending: Pending admin approval — ask a workspace owner/admin to approve this target here.
editor.conflict: This configuration was changed elsewhere. The latest version has been loaded — review and save again.

approvals.title: Approved external targets
approvals.empty: No approved group chats or topics yet.

revoke_dialog.title: Revoke this approval?
revoke_dialog.description: Queued messages to this target are cancelled. Messages already accepted by Feishu can't be recalled.

deliveries.title: Delivery records
deliveries.description: "Sent" means the Feishu platform accepted the message — it doesn't mean the recipient has read it.

detail.title: Delivery detail
detail.load_failed: The detail failed to load — the state above comes from the list row and may be stale.

retry.uncertain_description: This message may already have reached Feishu, but the platform's response was lost. Check the target first; retry only if it didn't arrive. A retry replays the same deduplication UUID, so within the platform's dedup window a confirmed message isn't sent twice.
retry.disabled: Only failed or uncertain deliveries can be retried.

error_code.condition_mismatch: The run result didn't match the send condition
error_code.member_unbound: The member's Feishu binding was removed
error_code.installation_missing: The bot installation no longer exists

error_code.lease_expired: The send claim expired before completion

error_code.route_target_unreachable: The bot can't reach this chat or message
error_code.route_topic_anchor_mismatch: The anchor message doesn't belong to this chat
error_code.route_authorization_lost: The rule author's automation permission was lost
error_code.route_target_not_approved: The target approval is missing or was revoked
error_code.source_unresolved: The historical run's mode couldn't be determined

error.route_invalid: The configuration is invalid. Check the fields and try again.
error.route_installation_invalid: The selected bot isn't available in this workspace.

error.route_target_unreachable: The bot can't reach this chat or message. Nothing was saved.
